---
title: "Search the guide"
subtitle: "Search by what you are trying to do, not by the word the register uses"
date: last-modified
---

The search box in the top right matches text exactly. This one also knows that
**emigration** is what you want when you type *moves abroad*, and that
**hfaudd** is what you want when you type *uddannelse*.

Danish works. The guide is in English, but the words you reach for are probably
not.

::: {.callout-tip}
Looking for a **column** rather than an explanation?
[Find a variable](find-a-variable.qmd) searches all 835 columns across every
register instead.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="gsearch">
  <input id="gs-q" type="search" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search the guide"
         placeholder="What are you trying to do? Try: people who move abroad, competing risk, matched controls">
  <p id="gs-count" class="gs-count"></p>
  <div id="gs-results"></div>
</div>

<style>
#gsearch { margin: 1.5rem 0; }
#gs-q { width: 100%; padding: .7rem .9rem; font-size: 1.05rem; border-radius: 6px;
        border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
        color: var(--bs-body-color, #111); }
.gs-count { font-size: .85rem; opacity: .75; margin: .7rem 0 0; }
.gs-hit { border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); padding: .9rem 0; }
.gs-where { font-size: .8rem; opacity: .7; }
.gs-head { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; margin: .15rem 0; }
.gs-head a { text-decoration: none; }
.gs-snip { font-size: .9rem; margin: .25rem 0 0; }
.gs-snip mark { background: rgba(255, 214, 0, .35); color: inherit; padding: 0 .1em; }
.gs-via { font-size: .8rem; opacity: .75; margin: .3rem 0 0; }
.gs-empty { padding: 1.5rem 0; opacity: .8; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var SECTIONS = [], SYN = [], EXPAND = {};

  // Without this, "folk der flytter til udlandet" matches almost every section,
  // because "der" and "til" are everywhere and drown the one word that matters.
  var STOP = ("a an and are as at be but by can do does for from has have how i " +
    "if in is it its me my of on or that the their then there they this to was " +
    "what when where which who why will with you your " +
    "af alle at bruge da de den der det dette du eller en er et for fra gør har " +
    "hvad hvor hvordan hvorfor hvilke hvilken i ikke jeg kan man med mig min mine " +
    "og om på selv skal som til ved vi").split(" ");
  var q = document.getElementById("gs-q"),
      out = document.getElementById("gs-results"),
      count = document.getElementById("gs-count");

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c];
    });
  }

  // Every term in a synonym group expands to the whole group. Longer terms are
  // matched first so "flytter til udlandet" wins over "udlandet" alone.
  function buildExpand() {
    SYN.forEach(function (group) {
      group.forEach(function (term) {
        EXPAND[term.toLowerCase()] = group.map(function (t) { return t.toLowerCase(); });
      });
    });
  }

  function expand(query) {
    var lower = " " + query.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}_ -]/gu, " ") + " ";
    var words = lower.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    var terms = words.filter(function (w) { return STOP.indexOf(w) === -1 && w.length > 1; });
    if (!terms.length) terms = words;  // a query of nothing but stop words

    var extra = [], via = [];
    Object.keys(EXPAND).forEach(function (term) {
      var hit;
      if (term.indexOf(" ") !== -1) {
        hit = lower.indexOf(" " + term + " ") !== -1;
      } else {
        // Danish inflects and compounds: "stien" should reach "sti", and
        // "doedsdato" should reach "doed". A prefix match in either direction
        // does both. The floor is three characters and the ending is capped at
        // six, which covers -en, -et, -erne and a joined second word without
        // letting "kom" swallow "kommunikation".
        hit = terms.some(function (w) {
          if (w === term) return true;
          if (term.length < 3 || w.length < 3) return false;
          if (w.indexOf(term) === 0) return w.length - term.length <= 6;
          if (term.indexOf(w) === 0) return term.length - w.length <= 6;
          return false;
        });
      }
      if (hit) {
        EXPAND[term].forEach(function (t) { if (extra.indexOf(t) === -1) extra.push(t); });
        if (via.indexOf(term) === -1) via.push(term);
      }
    });
    return { terms: terms, all: terms.concat(extra), via: via, extra: extra };
  }

  function score(sec, all, terms) {
    // The anchor counts as a heading. An explicit {#fastreg-paths} is the
    // author labelling the section, and it often carries the word the reader
    // types when the prose does not.
    var head = (sec.heading + " " + sec.title + " " +
                (sec.anchor || "").replace(/-/g, " ")).toLowerCase(),
        body = sec.text.toLowerCase(),
        code = (sec.code || "").toLowerCase(), s = 0;
    all.forEach(function (t) {
      var typed = terms.indexOf(t) !== -1;
      if (head.indexOf(t) !== -1) s += typed ? 12 : 6;
      // Identifiers from the code blocks. "How do I set the fastreg path" is
      // answered by a line of code, and the prose around it never says "path".
      if (code.indexOf(t) !== -1) s += typed ? 4 : 2;
      var n = body.split(t).length - 1;
      if (n) s += (typed ? 3 : 1.5) * Math.min(n, 4);
    });
    return s;
  }

  function snippet(text, all) {
    var lower = text.toLowerCase(), at = -1, hit = "";
    all.some(function (t) { var i = lower.indexOf(t); if (i !== -1) { at = i; hit = t; return true; } });
    if (at === -1) return esc(text.slice(0, 200)) + "...";
    var from = Math.max(0, at - 90), to = Math.min(text.length, at + 150);
    var s = esc((from ? "..." : "") + text.slice(from, to) + (to < text.length ? "..." : ""));
    all.forEach(function (t) {
      if (!t) return;
      // escape every non-word character so a term like "c_opr (main)" is literal
      var safe = t.replace(/[^\w\s]/g, "\\$&");
      s = s.replace(new RegExp("(" + safe + ")", "gi"), "<mark>$1</mark>");
    });
    return s;
  }

  function render() {
    if (!q.value.trim()) { out.innerHTML = ""; count.textContent = ""; return; }
    var e = expand(q.value);
    var hits = SECTIONS.map(function (sec) { return { sec: sec, s: score(sec, e.all, e.terms) }; })
                       .filter(function (h) { return h.s > 0; })
                       .sort(function (a, b) { return b.s - a.s; });

    count.textContent = hits.length + " section" + (hits.length === 1 ? "" : "s") +
      (e.extra.length ? ", including matches on " + e.extra.slice(0, 6).join(", ") : "");

    if (!hits.length) {
      out.innerHTML = '<p class="gs-empty">Nothing found. Try a single word, or a column name on ' +
        '<a href="find-a-variable.html">Find a variable</a>. If a search you expected to work ' +
        'came up empty, the feedback box below is how that gets fixed.</p>';
      return;
    }

    out.innerHTML = hits.slice(0, 25).map(function (h) {
      var sec = h.sec;
      var href = sec.page.replace(/\.qmd$/, ".html") + (sec.anchor ? "#" + sec.anchor : "");
      return '<div class="gs-hit">' +
        '<div class="gs-where">' + esc(sec.title) + "</div>" +
        '<div class="gs-head"><a href="' + esc(href) + '">' +
          esc(sec.heading || sec.title) + "</a></div>" +
        '<p class="gs-snip">' + snippet(sec.text, e.all) + "</p>" +
        "</div>";
    }).join("") + (hits.length > 25
      ? '<p class="gs-empty">Showing the 25 best matches.</p>' : "");
  }

  fetch("assets/search-index.json")
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (d) {
      SECTIONS = d.sections; SYN = d.synonyms || [];
      buildExpand();
      q.addEventListener("input", render);
      var pre = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("q");
      if (pre) { q.value = pre; render(); }
      q.focus();
    })
    .catch(function () {
      out.innerHTML = '<p class="gs-empty">The search index could not be loaded. ' +
        "It is generated from the guide by <code>just build-search-index</code>.</p>";
    });
})();
</script>
```
